title: Live-run authorization is not bound
observation: commitDomain accepts a valid candidate and in-band givens without a live run, event trace, action binding or render observation. A completed synthetic grid produced a domain in the in-memory probe.
required_resolution: Put a one-use, action/revision/profile-bound run coordinator in front of the sole mutation boundary; do not accept arbitrary final grids or replay records as authorization.

title: Duplicate boards count as two fresh boards
observation: Two copies of the same g=2 givens/candidate pair issued one READY envelope. Batch length is checked; distinctness and prior-use provenance are not.
required_resolution: Bind each board fingerprint and batch index; reject duplicates and cross-action reuse, then persist consumed authorization identifiers with the resource.

title: Draft integrity is asserted by the caller
observation: Changing the body while retaining the old digest was accepted by sendLocal and stored in a delivery row. issuePermit also accepted an unregistered sender and external recipient in a caller-forged FrozenDraft. TypeScript annotations do not perform runtime validation.
required_resolution: Centralize canonicalization and digest recomputation, copy frozen data, and validate the full draft and sender at issue/send. Compare against the recorded permit content, not only a supplied digest string.

title: Send does not re-resolve recipient membership
observation: A synthetic READY permit edited to name outsider@example.com generated a local delivery row with that mailbox string. No network mail was sent; this is a registry-integrity failure, not a demonstrated SMTP relay.
required_resolution: Revalidate every unique recipient in the current locked instance immediately before spending; reject the whole transition when any membership or authorized-recipient binding differs.

title: Horizon masks exact permit retry
observation: After issuance advances g to 3, calling issuePermit with the identical draft returns the horizon refusal before reaching its existing-permit lookup. The original W05 promise is not true on this path.
required_resolution: Separate exact read-only operation retrieval from new issuance, or perform validated idempotency lookup before the new-issuance gate. Never create a replacement or reset g.

title: Invalid storage may become an empty writable instance
observation: loadInstance validates only selected top-level fields, not spentPermits or nested relations. Syntactically invalid JSON falls through catch to emptyInstance without quarantine. A structurally rejected value is copied to one overwriteable quarantine key, then empty state can be persisted. Missing spentPermits caused sendLocal to throw in the probe.
required_resolution: Version and validate the complete schema; distinguish absent storage from corrupt storage; preserve raw bytes without overwriting them; require recovery before writes; return structured failures rather than TypeError.

title: UI success precedes coordinated persistence
observation: Registry transitions update React state and an effect writes localStorage later. There is no reviewed exclusive cross-tab writer, registry revision, atomic receipt boundary, write error handling or read-back decision. Inbox/send labels therefore do not establish successful persistence.
required_resolution: Centralize all mutations under an exclusive origin lock, re-read/revalidate, persist one snapshot plus receipt, read back, then render success. Treat ambiguous acknowledgment as recovery-needed, not a new send.

title: Composition/cancellation lacks a full lifecycle fence
observation: Recipient, subject and body controls remain editable during solving. Preparation is synchronous inside a delayed callback; stopRun does not invalidate that callback with a run generation token. Long preparation can block interaction.
required_resolution: Freeze or separate the active composer; use cancellable bounded preparation and a generation/run fence at each asynchronous result; cancel on stop/unmount and reject late commits.

title: Event processing is not per-event visual evidence
observation: The timer processes up to speed events synchronously while updating React state. The UI stores only a latest-event label and aggregate guesses/retractions, not a complete bounded audit trace or render acknowledgments. Separate DOM paints for every logical event were not observed.
required_resolution: Keep 24 logical events/tick, distinguish event records from rendered checkpoints, provide bounded trace/step access and initial/final paint gates, and test the headed view.

title: Dealer budget and uniqueness outcomes need hardening
observation: dealPlayable handles SEARCH_SOLVED before its events>cap check, and does not explicitly require g=2 retractions. countSolutions can return one after its node budget is exceeded if one solution was found, despite incomplete enumeration; it also returns one for a completed duplicate-filled grid. fill has no explicit node/deadline bound.
required_resolution: Return typed complete/incomplete uniqueness results, validate givens, make caps inclusive with no cap+1 acceptance, enforce retractions, and bound/cancel preparation. The uniqueness exhaustion path is a static finding; no budget-exhaustion seed was measured here.

title: Caller can substitute a different box geometry
observation: A Latin-square candidate invalid under PLAYED was accepted for a domain when the caller supplied 1x16 boxes. The in-band test checks cell count rather than the required topology identity.
required_resolution: Require the exact profile topology at the issuance boundary and validate topology before helper searches. Utility topology support cannot override the played profile.

title: A second domain can consume the only envelope ordinal
observation: After creating one domain, another domain with two boards is accepted and moves g to 3. This prevents the requested domain-then-envelope journey. The series refinement reserves g=2 for that envelope rather than changing the horizon.
required_resolution: Enforce the selected action lifecycle in both UI admission and registry transition. Preserve already-existing incompatible states read-only; do not erase them to produce the happy path.

title: Local mailbox labels do not enforce local hosting
observation: The dev command and config bind 0.0.0.0:8080; preview is configured for 127.0.0.1:8081. Root auth/provider, preview bridge, PWA and server plugins remain in the app. No browser/process network capture was taken.
required_resolution: Add a separately selected literal-loopback runtime profile, preserve the hosted preview contract distinctly, and inspect activated browser/server dependencies. Do not certify egress denial from source labels.

title: The aggregate test script assumes a POSIX shell
observation: The npm test string uses semicolons, $?, shell assignments and a POSIX if expression. Its portability to ordinary Windows cmd.exe is not established. The direct Node Glyphoku test command did run on Linux.
required_resolution: Use direct Node test invocations or a reviewed cross-platform Node runner; verify Windows launch and exit propagation separately, without installing runtimes or bypassing OS security automatically.

title: Legacy test/sample claims cannot certify the revision
observation: The three existing tests passed but omit the demonstrated gaps. Original W07 asks to use the post-send g=3 instance for validators that should be reached at g=1/g=2, allowing horizon refusal to mask defects. Historical timings and the 4,800-control declaration are not a new assessment.
required_resolution: Use validator-specific preconditions and exact refusal reasons; measure new timings separately; preserve source assessments as NOT_ASSESSED and keep baseline/test-plan/implementation results distinct.
